The '''Theed Music Hall''' was a theater where popular musical entertainment took place. It was located in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. A rotunda with a domed roof covered in [[Color/Legends|green]] tile, the Music Hall contained a stage and a pit, from which specialized [[Droid/Legends|droids]] would come out and play music for the benefit of the audience. Spectators were seated in front of the stage, whether on ground-level or in balconies on the sides of the room.<ref name="ELAC" />
